claims.text: Many reviewers find these extensions a good value for the price, noting soft hair and generous amount per weft.
A common complaint is that the hair tangles easily and requires frequent brushing.
Reviewers report the color blends well with natural hair and looks as expected.
Several reviewers note limitations with heat styling, saying it does not curl well or cannot be re-curled after straightening.
Some reviewers mention a strong chemical smell and difficulty dyeing the hair.
